bd.gridShrinkBlocked: Some keys occupy that row or column
bd.caption: {profile} · {r} × {c} · {used} of {total} keys in use
bd.slowOperation: The operation is taking too long. State reloaded, please check the result.
bd.pageBusyRetry: Another operation is still running. Wait a moment and try again.
bd.chooseKeyHint: Press any key on the board to edit its actions, icon and behaviour.
bd.emptyKeyHint: Drag an action from the library or press it to assign it here.
bd.keyBadgeHint: Number over the icon (supports variables in double braces)
bd.noActions: This key does nothing yet. Pick an action from the library.
bd.pressKindHint: Each press type has its own list. Double and triple wait ~340 ms so a single click does not fire first. Rules with the same trigger run after the list.
bd.useModeHint: Press keys to run them. Folders take you to their page.
bd.kioskExitMsg: You will return to the normal use mode with the bar and settings visible.
bd.kioskHint: Tap the top-right corner 3 times or press Escape to exit.
bd.kioskKeepAwakeFallback: Screen kept on via video (compatibility mode)
bd.kioskKeepAwakeOff: The screen may turn off: tap the screen or set Auto-Lock to Never
bd.actionsHint: Drag an action onto a key or press it to add it to the selected one. Also with Ctrl + K.
bd.paletteHint: Type to search. Use ↑ ↓ and Enter.
bd.codeCopyHint: Select it and copy with Ctrl + C
bd.exportSummary: Copy this code to share the key “{name}”.
bd.importIntro: Paste a key code or pick a .json file.
bd.invalidKeyCode: This code does not look like a BunDeck key.
bd.notValidJson: Not valid JSON. Check you copied it whole.
bd.codeOnlyTag: Defined in code: only install if you trust its origin
bd.trustWarning: Imported JSON is treated as data, never as code. Check where it comes from before installing anything.
bd.willReplace: It will replace the current key at {pos}. You can undo it.
bd.noFreeSlot: No free slots on this page. Select a key to replace.
bd.pressLogsEmpty: No logs yet. Press the key to generate the first one.
bd.pressLogsClearConfirm: Delete the logs in this scope?
bd.useModeExportHint: Right-click to export or import keys.
bd.rulesHint: Rules run after the actions. Combine a trigger, a condition and what should happen when it holds or not.
bd.rulesHintShort: With rules you can react to long presses, timers or variables. See the Rules tab.
bd.looksHint: The first condition that holds changes how the key looks. Use the variable in double braces in the title to show values.
bd.keyVarsHint: Variables read or written by this key's actions, rules and appearance, with their current value.
bd.keyVarsEmpty: This key doesn't use variables yet. Add a Logic action or a condition to see them here.
bd.availVarsHint: Key ones are driven by the action (read-only). Global ones can be edited here. Click a name to copy it.
bd.availVarAutoHint: Controlled automatically by the action — read-only
bd.availVarEditHint: Global variable: edit its value here
bd.availVarsEmpty: This key doesn't expose variables yet. Add a stateful action (Discord, OBS, mixer, multimedia) or create a global in Settings → Variables.
bd.presetDlgMsg: There are already {n} appearance conditions and the new action brings its own states ({vars}: {m} new). What should we do with the conditions?
bd.presetDlgMsgNoLooks: The new action brings its own states ({vars}). Should we add their {m} appearance conditions?
bd.presetHint: Shortcuts for this key: they add the condition with its title, icon and colors.
bd.toggleHint: Create a yes/no variable, add “Toggle variable” to click and an appearance for the on state. Then tweak the icons.
bd.toggleOk: Toggle created: press Test to see the icon change.
bd.statesHint: Multiple icons for one key, driven by a numeric variable: state 0 is the base and each state N shows when variable == N. Under Transitions you choose which press type changes the state.
bd.statesBaseHint: State 0 uses the icon, title and colors above (base). Define states 1, 2, … here.
bd.transHint: What each press type does to the state. This adds or updates a “Set variable” action in that press list (visible in the Actions tab).
bd.varsSub: Global variables: read them in any condition and change them from any action.
bd.varBadName: Use letters, numbers and _; not starting with a number
bd.helpOps: Operators: + - * / % · == != · < > <= >= · and or not · cond ? a : b
bd.helpFns: Functions: abs min max round floor aleatorio(n) longitud(t) mayus(t) minus(t) contiene(s, t) texto(v) numero(v)
bd.helpBuiltins: Built-ins: hour minute second day (1 = Monday) profile page. In texts you can write the variable in double braces.
bd.selectKeyFirst: Select a key on the board first
bd.settingsResultsHint: Pick a result to jump to that setting.
bd.logsSub: Service status and daemon log. Use it to diagnose why a device shows nothing.
bd.diagApiHint: The daemon is not responding at this URL. Start it with LAN access ("./dev.sh dev" or LIBREDECK_BIND_LAN=1) and open the LAN address on the tablet (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:4321).
bd.diagWsHint: WebSocket disconnected: changes from other devices will not arrive live until it reconnects.
bd.generalSub: How the app behaves on your computer.
bd.startWithSystemHint: Open BunDeck when you turn on your computer.
bd.autostartError: Could not save the start-with-system setting.
bd.startMinimizedHint: When starting automatically, keep only the tray icon (no window).
bd.startMinimizedError: Could not save the start-minimized setting.
bd.autoSwitchHint: Activates the profile linked to the foreground app.
bd.devicesIntro: Configure the connected Stream Deck and prepare the devices that will show your pages.
bd.deviceHardwareSub: Select and adjust the Stream Deck connected to this computer.
bd.deviceListSub: Detected hardware and accepted browsers show up on their own: they are never added by hand. Here you can rename or forget them (forgetting also blocks them from coming back). Access is approved in Remote control.
bd.browsersSub: Browsers and phones that have entered this BunDeck. Forgetting revokes their access and removes them everywhere.
bd.devicesEmpty: No devices yet: open the web UI in an accepted browser or plug in your Stream Deck and it will show up here.
bd.devicesManageHint: Access is approved or revoked in Remote control.
bd.longPressTimeHint: How long a key must be held.
bd.clickSoundHint: A soft click when a key fires.
bd.hwBrightnessHint: Intensity of the selected Stream Deck. Each device keeps its own.
bd.idleMinutesHint: Idle minutes before the rest action. 0 = never.
bd.idleActionHint: What the device does when resting. Any press wakes it.
bd.uiBrightnessHint: Key intensity on this screen. Does not affect hardware.
bd.noHwSelected: Select a Stream Deck to adjust its display.
bd.streamdeckDeviceHint: The Stream Deck controlled by BunDeck on this computer.
bd.profilesSub: Each profile keeps its own pages and folders.
bd.backupSub: Save a portable copy of your complete BunDeck configuration.
bd.backupExportSub: Creates a JSON file with profiles, pages, buttons, settings, devices, plugins, and assets.
bd.backupSensitiveWarning: The file may include MCP tokens, credentials saved by plugins, and other private data. Store it securely and share it only with people you trust.
bd.backupFullHint: Image assets are included in the file when available.
bd.deleteProfileMsg: Delete profile “{name}” with all its pages and buttons? This cannot be undone.
bd.autoBannerHint: Switch profiles automatically when a PC app or window is focused.
bd.autoSub: Switch the active profile based on the foreground window or app.
bd.autoEnableHint: BunDeck will watch the active system window and switch profiles instantly.
bd.autoDefaultHint: Used when the current window matches no rule.
bd.autoOrderHint: Rules are evaluated top to bottom; the first match wins.
bd.autoEmptyHint: Add a rule to link a window or program to one of your profiles.
bd.autoCaptureHint: Fill in with the simulated window below
bd.autoSimHint: Pick a window to check which profile BunDeck would select.
bd.appearanceSub: Tune the look of the app and the board.
bd.pluginsSub: Install, update and build plugins with AI.
bd.paletteHint: Changes the colours of the whole app.
bd.keyLabelsHint: When the text under the icon shows.
bd.animationsHint: Motion on press, panel folding and dialog opening.
bd.shortcutsSub: Global shortcuts, active even when BunDeck is in the background.
bd.shortcutGlobalHint: They work with the window focused. The launcher also registers them as system-wide hotkeys (Windows): with the window unfocused, whoever captures first wins.
bd.advancedSub: For those who want to look under the hood.
bd.resetSettingsHint: Erases profiles, pages, buttons, variables and settings, then restores factory defaults.
bd.resetConfirmBody: All profiles and pages will be deleted, including yours. This cannot be undone.
bd.resetAck: I understand my profiles and pages will be deleted
bd.aboutText: A physical key panel made on screen. Local, fast and account-free.
bd.aboutReview: Interface reviewed with the unslop skill by Damir Sokolovsky (X: heydamir), CC BY 4.0 licence.
bd.aboutGuideHint: Brush up on the BunDeck basics in five quick steps.
bd.welcomeS0Desc: Turn your screen, phone or Stream Deck into a touch control panel. Everything runs locally, no accounts or subscriptions.
bd.welcomeImportDesc: If you used the official Elgato app, we import your profiles as-is: always as a new profile, without touching what you have.
bd.welcomeS1Desc: Open the Library on the left and drag any action onto a key, or press Ctrl + K to find it instantly.
bd.welcomeS2Desc: Make the same key change colour, count taps or run different actions depending on the time or whether your mic is muted.
bd.welcomeS3Title: 4. Use it on your computer, phone or tablet
bd.welcomeS3Desc: Open the QR code at the top right to control the board from your phone, or switch to Free mode to design any-size buttons.
bd.sdImportHint: Bring your official Elgato app profiles in as new “(imported)” profiles: your current setup stays untouched.
bd.sdImportNotFound: No Stream Deck profiles found on this computer. You can upload an exported .streamDeckProfile instead.
bd.sdImportSelectHint: Tick the ones you want to bring in.
bd.sdNoSelection: Tick at least one profile or upload a file.
bd.sdPendingNote: Pending ones keep their title and image with a note: they do nothing until you configure them.
bd.sdFromBackup: Coming from Stream Deck? Import your official profiles without leaving this page.
bd.catalogCompatibleOnlyHint: Hide plugins requiring a newer app version
bd.catalogLoadError: Could not load the local catalog.
bd.catalogPrivilegedHint: Requests broad system access: install only if you trust the author
bd.dropHint: Drag a .plectro or .zip file, or pick it from your computer.
bd.invalidPlugin: “{name}” is not a valid plugin. Use a .plectro or .zip file.
bd.pluginNoSettings: This plugin has no general settings.
bd.spotifyWaiting: Opening the Web Player… log in and come back here; the token is stored locally.
bd.spotifyConnected: Connected: the token renews itself in the background while the app stays open.
bd.spotifyConnectHint: No Client ID needed: your official Web Player session is used in its own window (iframes are blocked by Spotify).
bd.discordWaiting: Connecting via LibreDeck… accept the permission (“Authorize” popup) and come back here; the token is stored locally.
bd.discordConnected: Connected: voice is controlled in the background (no focus needed) and the token renews itself.
bd.discordConnectHint: One click on Authorize: no need to create any app or copy keys. Discord will ask for permission once. Without this step, global hotkeys are used.
bd.discordAuthorizeHint: If the browser did not open on its own, authorize manually:
bd.discordAdvancedTitle: Advanced (power-users with their own app only)
bd.discordAdvancedBody: By default LibreDeck uses its own Discord app: leave everything blank. Only if you want your own app, create it at discord.com/developers/applications and paste its Client ID, Secret and Redirect here; the exchange will be direct without going through the relay.
bd.discordDefaultsNote: Blank = LibreDeck defaults (zero-config, 1 click). Only change something if you use your own Discord app.
bd.discordSecretBody: Power-users with their own app only: its Client Secret. With your own Secret the exchange goes directly to discord.com; without it, it goes through the LibreDeck relay (the secret lives on the server, never on your machine).
bd.discordNotConfigured: Discord relay not configured by the maintainer yet: use the global-hotkeys fallback in the meantime.
bd.discordNotConnected: Not connected: press Authorize and accept the permission in Discord (“Authorize” popup). Without this step, global hotkeys are used.
bd.discordClosed: Discord isn't open on this computer: open it and we'll keep trying on our own. Meanwhile, global hotkeys are used.
bd.discordAuthorized: Authorized: token saved. Open Discord on this computer to control it in the background.
bd.spotifyHostWindow: Spotify was opened on the host machine: sign in there and access will complete automatically.
bd.spotifyRemoteHint: If you're on another device, you can also paste the token manually in settings or open
bd.pluginNeedsRuntime: Imported from Elgato: native CodePath or missing bundle (not runnable). Reinstall from the compiled .streamDeckPlugin.
bd.noPlugins: You haven't installed any plugin yet.
bd.mcpUrlLabel: This BunDeck is the MCP server
bd.mcpHintSelf: Point your MCP client (Claude Code, etc.) at this URL with a token to control EVERYTHING: profiles, pages, buttons (icon, texts, actions and order), widgets, flows, automations, variables, plugins, settings and logs.
bd.mcpSub: Your BunDeck as an MCP server: full control with per-token permissions.
bd.mcpAdminWarning: A token with all permissions can change EVERYTHING: profiles, pages, buttons, actions, plugins and settings. Grant only what is needed and revoke tokens you don't use.
bd.webhooksSub: Local-only HTTP endpoints that run a list of actions when called (e.g. switch profile from Home Assistant). They never work over relay/tunnel.
bd.webhooksLocalOnly: Local network only: these URLs never work over the internet (relay/tunnel returns 403).
bd.webhookNoActions: No actions yet: add at least one.
bd.webhookConfirmDelete: Delete webhook “{name}”? This disables its URL.
bd.webhookNoHooks: No webhooks yet. Create one for your smart home.
bd.mcpNoTokens: No tokens yet. Create one for your MCP client.
bd.mcpTokenOnce: Copy it now: the secret won't be shown again.
bd.aiNeedToken: Manage your tokens in Settings → MCP: create one with the permissions you need and point your MCP client at this server.
bd.aiProposal: Your MCP client can already control everything: profiles, pages, buttons (icon, texts, actions), widgets, flows, automations, variables, plugins, settings and logs. Create a token in Settings → MCP and use it from Claude Code.
bd.mcpHint: Connect an MCP server and the AI can see its tools to build your plugin.
bd.aiHint: Tell the AI what you want to automate. Some ideas:
bd.aiPlaceholder: Describe what you want your plugin to do…
bd.dropImage: Drop an image here or press to choose one
bd.imageHint: PNG, JPG and WebP are normalized to a single format; animated GIFs are kept as-is.
bd.qrHint: Point your phone camera at the code to open BunDeck.
bd.lanDeniedTitle: No permission to control this BunDeck
bd.lanDeniedMsg: You entered directly over the network without an invitation. For security, only whoever arrives with the host's QR code or link can control this machine.
bd.lanDeniedHint: Ask the host to show you the QR from Settings → Remote access or via the QR button in the top bar (Open on mobile), or to send you the invite link.
bd.lanDeniedRelayFallback: You came from the internet link and the local invite is no longer valid (used or expired). Copy your relay code ({code}) to go back to the link tab, or ask the host for a new QR. This page never redirects on its own.
bd.tunnelGoneMsg: This session no longer exists: the host machine may have restarted or be offline. It restores itself on reconnect; otherwise ask the host for a new QR code.
bd.tunnelGoneHint: Press Retry to reload. If the machine is still offline, wait a few seconds and try again.
bd.lanInviteHint: The QR and the link carry the same invitation (single use, expires in 15 min). Whoever opens it can control this BunDeck; revoke it when done.
bd.lanInviteHostOnly: Open the panel at http://localhost on the host to manage invitations.
bd.qrError: Could not generate the QR code.
bd.iosMessage: You are using iOS with a browser other than Safari. On iOS, fullscreen only works in Safari.
bd.iosHint: Open BunDeck in Safari for fullscreen. Tip: in Safari use Share → “Add to Home Screen” for the best experience.
bd.sdConflictTitle: The official Stream Deck app is open
bd.sdConflictMessage: Elgato's official app is using the Stream Deck, so BunDeck cannot control it while it stays open.
bd.sdConflictHint: Press “Close Stream Deck and continue” to quit it. You cannot continue while it stays open. If you quit it yourself, this warning goes away on its own.
bd.sdConflictStillOpen: It is still open. Quit it (you can also quit it yourself) and press “Check again”.
bd.remoteSub: Control this BunDeck from a browser or link another BunDeck. Approve connections and manage their permissions here.
bd.remotePairSub: Connect two computers that both run BunDeck (e.g. press a key here and switch the OBS scene on your streaming PC). Commands travel end-to-end encrypted and the server cannot read them.
bd.remotePairNeedBoth: Both computers need BunDeck installed. To enter from a phone without BunDeck, use the section below.
bd.remoteE2eNote: End-to-end encrypted (NaCl box, X25519). TLS is not E2E: the relay only sees metadata, never keys or actions. The private key never leaves this machine; shell and arbitrary HTTP stay blocked.
bd.remoteDisabled: Relay disabled on this machine. Local QR pairing still works.
bd.remotePairHint: A 6-digit code (10 min) plus this device's key fingerprint. The other BunDeck types the code and verifies the fingerprint.
bd.remoteRotateHint: Generates a new key pair. Unlinks every device: they will have to pair again.
bd.remoteQrHint: Show this QR on the other BunDeck to pair it without typing codes.
bd.remoteQrWarn: It expires soon. Don't share it outside your devices or show it fullscreen.
bd.remoteQrUpdate: Your daemon doesn't generate QRs yet (missing GET /api/v1/remote/qr). Update the daemon to use this section.
bd.remoteScanHint: From this computer, scan the QR shown by the other BunDeck to pair.
bd.remoteScanNoCam: No camera access (no camera or permission denied). You can paste the QR content below.
bd.remoteScanBad: That content is not a valid pairing QR.
bd.remoteScanVersion: Unsupported QR (version other than v1). Update the app.
bd.remoteScanFpBad: The QR fingerprint has an invalid format.
bd.remoteRelayMismatch: The QR carries a different relay than this device. If the local relay has no URL, set RELAY_URL on the daemon first. You can still confirm the local pairing.
bd.remoteRelaySub: Server that forwards remote traffic. The public relay is used by default; you can use your own or disable it.
bd.remoteRelayEnvHint: Ignored via env: remove RELAY_URL and restart the daemon for Settings to take effect.
bd.remoteRelayInvalid: Invalid relay URL: use ws(s):// (or http(s)://).
bd.remoteRelayReconnect: Saving reconnects the relay and tunnel; it may take a few seconds.
bd.remoteUiSub: Open and control this BunDeck from any browser (e.g. your phone away from home) through the relay. Every browser needs your approval.
bd.remoteUiAllowHint: Off by default. Whoever runs the relay can see what you do on the page, so only use it if you trust them. You can cut access instantly by turning the switch off or revoking the code.
bd.remoteUiUpdate: Your daemon doesn't support remote UI yet (missing /api/v1/remote/ui-*). Update the daemon to use this section.
bd.remoteUiTunnelDown: No connection to the relay: new codes will show as expired on the phone until the tunnel connects. Check your internet connection and network (firewall).
bd.remoteRelayAuthRequired: This device is not linked to the relay yet.
bd.remoteRelayAuthAuto: Linking happens automatically when the status refreshes.
bd.remoteRelayInvalidToken: The relay link is no longer valid.
bd.remoteRelayRateLimited: The relay rate-limited linking, try again in a few minutes.
bd.remoteRelayUnsupported: The relay is old and does not support linking: update it or use the public one.
bd.remoteRelayUnlinkConfirm: Unlink this device from the relay?
bd.remoteRelayRotateConfirm: Rotate the relay token? This device stays linked.
bd.remoteUiOpenHint: Creates a one-time code and its QR to open this BunDeck in your phone's browser.
bd.remoteUiRevokeConfirm: There are {n} pending requests. Revoke the active code?
bd.remoteUiApprovalHint: A browser wants to connect to this BunDeck.
bd.remoteUiApprovalWarning: Approve only if you recognize this device. If approved, it can control this BunDeck from its browser.
bd.remoteUiTransportNotice: Transport: it will try a direct encrypted P2P (WebRTC) connection between both devices; if the network does not allow it, it will use the relay (the relay operator can see the traffic). You will see the actual transport (P2P/Relay) in the sessions list.
bd.remoteUiApprovedConnecting: Establishing secure connection… trying direct P2P
bd.remoteUiDeviceNameHint: It will be saved as the device name in the Devices list.
bd.tunnelConnectSubSearching: Looking for a route to the BunDeck host
bd.tunnelConnectSubRelay: P2P blocked by NAT — using the relay
bd.kioskLogLanMiss: Local network: no response from {ips} ({ms} ms)
bd.kioskConnLogEmpty: No attempts recorded in this session yet.
bd.remoteUiTokenWarn: Save it now: it won't be shown again.
bd.gsAddHint: Create a 1×1 key in the first free slot. Drag from the handle to move, from the corner to resize.
bd.actControlHint: Interactive control: it owns the key surface and replaces it with its own component. Only one fits per key.
bd.actDataHint: Live data: its value shows inside the standard key, which keeps its icon and text.
bd.actFreeOnlyHint: This control only renders in Free mode. In Fixed mode the key looks normal.
bd.controlReplaceMsg: This key already uses the “{old}” control, which fills its whole surface. Replace it with “{new}”?
bd.controlExists: This key already has this control.
bd.controlNeedsFree: Added. Controls only show in Free mode; in Fixed mode the key looks normal.
bd.actionNoParams: This action has no options of its own.
bd.actionNoExtraConfig: This action doesn't need additional configuration.
bd.actionPluginSettingsHint: Connection details and defaults are managed in {plugin} settings.
bd.gsEmpty: Empty page. Add your first key to start.
bd.gsNoRoom: No free slot in the grid.
bd.freeNote: Free mode: phones and tablets only (incompatible with Stream Deck)
bd.deviceNoScreenHint: {name} has no screen in the “{profile}” profile. Assign one under Devices.
bd.deviceCompatFree: is in free mode and a Stream Deck only supports grid
bd.confirmFreeTitle: This page is shown on a Stream Deck
bd.confirmFreeMsg: “{page}” is assigned to {devices}. A Stream Deck cannot show free mode, so it will be unassigned. Your buttons are kept: free mode only adds geometry.
bd.confirmResizeTitle: This size does not fit your Stream Deck
bd.confirmResizeMsg: “{page}” would become {size}, but {devices} needs exactly its size. The page will be unassigned from that device.
bd.devicesSub: Set each device’s type and model here. Assign its page from the profile. Stream Decks only support grids of their exact size; phones and tablets also support free mode.
bd.deviceHwUnknown: HW not identified: using the configured model
bd.deviceNoCompatible: No page in this profile is a {size} grid
bd.deckEmpty: No layout yet. Create one to start.
bd.deckGridHint: Drag widgets to move them. Arrow keys move the selected widget.
bd.deckAddHint: Drag a widget onto the grid or click to add it.
bd.deckPairHint: Point your phone camera at the code to open this layout in use-only mode.
bd.actionNoConfig: No configuration available for this action
